facts.fact: Gemma 的秘密画室：她随手拿起名叫「Broken Promises」的灰色颜料开始涂抹。
facts.anchor: I pick up one of the paints aptly named Broken Promises.

facts.fact: 两小时后画成——她无意识把 Oliver 的脸画上了画布。
facts.anchor: Breathing heavily, I lean back onto my heels and face to face with Oliver.

facts.fact: 她的愤怒辩护：生气比道歉容易——「So angry I will be」；虽然心里承认「It wasn't his fault」。
facts.anchor: But it’s easier to be angry than apologetic.

facts.fact: 弟弟生日当天视频：Jake 亮出驾照——她连生日都忘了，只许诺考完回去补。
facts.anchor: Jake, I’m so sorry. I was meant to message you about your birthday today

facts.fact: Jake 的劝和辞令：他见过全家了——你这种 crazy 他能应付。
facts.anchor: He’s met the family. He can deal with your kind of crazy.

facts.fact: 考日出门才发现毛衣穿错了——是他的：气味一上来就是农场之夜。
facts.anchor: this isn’t my jumper. It’s his.

facts.fact: Greg 寿司猫从农场带回家——她舍不得那些记忆，尽管它只会用眼神审判她。
facts.anchor: I’m starting to regret bringing him home from the farm

facts.fact: 考前十分钟泪落桌面时的决定：过了这场考试就去找他。
facts.anchor: If I pass this exam, I’ll talk to him.

facts.fact: 决定升级：过考就告诉他心意——不说的那个选项让「及格」有了新的含义。
facts.anchor: And when the alternative is not telling him, I realise this all meant more than just passing.
